svg.text: Lane B — V2X_ECU/: one strictly sequential codec chain, one parallel binding
Groups 0.2 and 0.3 (V2X side). Every C++ step is verified on GitHub Actions — the dev host has no Docker or WSL.
6 .json + .uper pairs, committed by the CI run that proved them stable
consumed by 1.0.2.5 in this lane and by 1.0.5.1 in lane D
Strictly sequential: 1.0.2.1 → 1.0.2.2 → 1.0.2.3 → 1.0.2.4 → 1.0.2.5. Each step is the previous step's compile-time input.
Parallel: 2.0.3.1 needs only the toolchain and the R2 schema, so it ran alongside the whole codec chain.
The corpus hand-off needed a workaround: the run artifact could not be downloaded, so a one-shot guarded CI step committed the vectors straight from the determinism-checked tree.
